title: Support integration exposed internal Confluence documentation
summary: One support-integration report received USD 12,500 split between two researchers.
root_cause: Support-system configuration extended external identities’ access into internal documentation.
impact: The vendor summary describes external access to internal Confluence material and limited modification.
defensive_takeaways: Separate customer-support identity from employee-documentation entitlement.
Review transitive permissions across third-party integrations.

reward.evidence_quote: rewarded red_darkin with a $5,000 bounty. … rewarded madara_ with a $7,500 bounty.
reward.evidence_location: Two award events May 30, 2025 at 21:16 UTC; ellipsis joins fragments.
reward.notes: Dollar notation appears in the report UI; USD denomination is contextual from HackerOne’s disclosure policy. Award events do not establish cash receipt. One-report total: USD 5,000 to red_darkin and USD 7,500 to madara_; neither recipient individually received USD 10,000.
